name: Overclockers UK - UK-region consumer accelerator channel (new stock, no refurb tier observed)
notes: Recorded to capture a REGIONAL and a RISK observation rather than a used price - deliberately NOT priced, because Overclockers UK publishes no refurbished accelerator tier in the extracted page. Live observation 2026-10-03: Asus GeForce RTX 4090 ROG Strix OC 24GB shown at GBP 2,299.99, explicitly marked 'Price reduced from GBP 2,539.99'. THE USEFUL CROSS-MARKET POINT: at roughly GBP 2,300 (about $3,100) for NEW UK RTX 4090 stock against a best observed US USED 4090 ask of $2,000-$3,000, buying used in the US and new in the UK were within about 1.6x of each other. For GeForce-class consumer silicon the used-versus-new arbitrage had largely closed - the cost of de-installation, testing, re-certification and return-friction eats most of the spread. Used pricing only pays when there is no new supply at all, which is the ex-datacenter A100/H100 case, not the consumer case. UK channel also carries PayPal protection and a 3-year in-store warranty model, and ships many items direct-from-UK with free shipping, which matters for post-Brexit import cost when comparing against US used stock.
